steps.label: Cointegration
steps.sub: a linear combo of LEVELS is stationary

code:
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import adfuller

X = sm.add_constant(x_prices)
model = sm.OLS(y_prices, X).fit()
beta = model.params[1]

spread = y_prices - beta * x_prices
adf_p = adfuller(spread)[1]  # low p -> stationary
caption: Regress, then ADF-test the residuals — a stationary spread means cointegration.

eyebrow: The direct test, and a trade signal
code:
from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import coint

score, p_value, crit = coint(y_prices, x_prices)
# H0: no cointegration; low p -> reject H0

z = (spread - spread.rolling(60).mean()) \
    / spread.rolling(60).std()
long_signal = z < -2
caption: coint() wraps Engle-Granger; a z-scored spread drives the pairs trade.
